early.name: Muster on the Green
early.hook: Farmhands want to drill with spears once the harvest is in, if someone will show them how.

middle.name: The Spring Levy
middle.hook: Captains from three villages ask to train their levies together before the roads dry.

late.name: The Grand Muster
late.hook: Every banner in the realm wants to march past the capital on the same day. It could be glorious or chaos.

early.name: The Unwatched Ford
early.hook: A ford on the Sellen has no lookout, and smugglers have noticed.

middle.name: The Dark Beacon
middle.hook: A border beacon went unlit for a week. Nobody can say why, or who was supposed to light it.

late.name: A Blind Frontier
late.hook: Scouts report a whole stretch of the border where no tower is manned.

early.name: Runaway Recruits
early.hook: Two young recruits fled the barracks and are hiding at their mother's farm.

middle.name: Empty Bunks
middle.hook: A company came up a dozen soldiers short the morning after payday.

late.name: The Broken Company
late.hook: An entire company has walked off its post, claiming it was promised land and never got it.

early.name: Crates from Restov
early.hook: A Restov trader has surplus spears and shields and wants them gone cheap.

middle.name: Mivoni Steel
middle.hook: A Mivoni smithy offers a contract for good blades, if the terms can be agreed.

late.name: The Dwarven Offer
late.hook: Envoys from a dwarven forge offer to outfit your guard for a price and a favor.

early.name: Toll on the Old Road
early.hook: A handful of thugs are charging travelers a copper apiece to pass a bend in the road.

middle.name: The Stockade Gang
middle.hook: An organized gang has thrown up a stockade and taxes every cart on the trade road.

late.name: The Robber Knight
late.hook: A disgraced knight has fortified a hill and calls the caravans' payments a lawful levy.

early.name: Old Soldiers' Grievance
early.hook: Men who fought for the realm's founding want their part remembered, and they're getting loud about it.

middle.name: The Pension Dispute
middle.hook: Wounded veterans say the treasury forgot the promises made to them.

late.name: March of the Wounded
late.hook: Hundreds of veterans have gathered outside the seat of government and won't leave.

early.name: Cattle Raid
early.hook: Riders from beyond the border drove off a farmer's herd in the night.

middle.name: Skirmish at the Line
middle.hook: A patrol clashed with foreign riders. Both sides say the other started it.

late.name: Probing Attack
late.hook: A neighbor's cavalry is testing your border forts, one at a time.

early.name: Quarterstaff Contest
early.hook: The village fair wants a fighting contest, and someone to keep it from turning into a brawl.

middle.name: Tourney of the Greenbelt
middle.hook: Brevic knights ask to hold a tourney on your fields.

late.name: Tourney of Champions
late.hook: Champions from across the River Kingdoms want to compete in your capital.

early.name: The Hedge Witch's Feud
early.hook: A hedge witch swears she didn't curse her neighbor's goats. The goats say otherwise.

middle.name: Duel of Charms
middle.hook: Two spellcasters' rivalry has soured a town's wells, and each blames the other.

late.name: Arcane Vendetta
late.hook: Two wizards' feud is leaving scorched streets and frightened townsfolk.

early.name: A Crate of Books
early.hook: A dying scholar wants their books to go somewhere they'll be read.

middle.name: The Restov Collection
middle.hook: A Restov archive is selling off a collection, and your scholars want it badly.

late.name: The Buried Library
late.hook: Scholars have found a library buried under an old ruin, if it can be dug out safely.

early.name: Lights over the Marsh
early.hook: Floating lights over the marsh are spooking herders and their animals.

middle.name: Witchfire
middle.hook: The marsh lights are drawing people out into the bog. Two haven't come back.

late.name: The Burning Sky
late.hook: Ribbons of raw magic flicker over the realm at night, and crops wilt where they touch down.

early.name: The Singed Apprentice
early.hook: An apprentice's cantrip set a barn alight. Everyone is fine; the barn is not.

middle.name: Loose in the Market
middle.hook: A summoned creature has got loose in the market and won't go back.

late.name: Rift in the Workshop
late.hook: A failed ritual left a tear in the air of a wizard's tower, and things are coming through.

early.name: The Farmer's Almanac
early.hook: A farmer who watches the stars offers to write a planting almanac for the realm.

middle.name: Observatory Plans
middle.hook: An astrologer wants to build an observatory and needs a patron.

late.name: The Great Conjunction
late.hook: Scholars predict a rare conjunction. A realm that prepares for it could gain a great deal.

early.name: The Unlucky Coin
early.hook: An old coin turned up in a field, and everyone who holds it has a run of bad luck.

middle.name: The Hungry Mirror
middle.hook: A mirror sold at market is wearing its owners thin, one by one.

late.name: Relic of a Fallen Realm
late.hook: A relic from a kingdom long gone has woken, and blight spreads around it.

early.name: A Village Schoolroom
early.hook: Parents want a teacher for their children and a room to teach in.

middle.name: The Academy Charter
middle.hook: A group of scholars asks for a charter to found an academy.

late.name: The University Petition
late.hook: Learned societies from three nations want to found a university in your capital.

early.name: The Bridge Toll
early.hook: A sprite demands a bowl of milk from everyone who crosses a certain bridge.

middle.name: Changeling Rumors
middle.hook: Parents in one village are certain their children have been swapped.

late.name: The Fey Lord's Due
late.hook: A fey noble has arrived to collect an old debt from the land itself.

early.name: Ditch Digging
early.hook: Farmers want a proper ditch dug to water the lower fields.

middle.name: The Mill Race
middle.hook: Millers want a race cut from the river to turn a second wheel.

late.name: The Great Canal
late.hook: Engineers propose a canal that would water a whole valley.

early.name: Rust in the Wheat
early.hook: Orange rust is spreading through one farmer's wheat. The neighbors are worried.

middle.name: Creeping Rot
middle.hook: A rot is moving from field to field faster than anyone can burn it.

late.name: Black Harvest
late.hook: A blight has blackened crops across a whole region.

early.name: The Washed-Out Footbridge
early.hook: Spring floods took the footbridge to the mill, and the long way round is very long.

middle.name: The Cracked Bridge
middle.hook: A stone bridge on the trade road has cracked through. Carts are still using it.

late.name: Collapse on the Sellen
late.hook: A major bridge has fallen into the river, and trade on that road has stopped.

early.name: First Market Day
early.hook: The village wants to hold its first proper market day.

middle.name: The Harvest Fair
middle.hook: Farmers want a harvest fair to sell their surplus and show off their best animals.

late.name: The Great Fair
late.hook: Merchants from across the region ask to hold a great fair in your lands.

early.name: The Foul Well
early.hook: The village well smells wrong, and two families have fallen sick.

middle.name: Sickly Cisterns
middle.hook: The town's cisterns are breeding sickness, and nobody remembers who built them.

late.name: The Tainted Aqueduct
late.hook: Something is fouling the aqueduct that feeds a whole city.

early.name: A Wagon of Settlers
early.hook: A family from Brevoy has arrived with a wagon and wants land to work.

middle.name: The Settler Caravan
middle.hook: A caravan of settlers asks where they may build.

late.name: The Great Migration
late.hook: Thousands fleeing war in a neighboring land are at your border, asking to stay.

early.name: Wolves at the Fold
early.hook: Wolves are taking sheep from the high pastures.

middle.name: Stalker in the Fields
middle.hook: Something large is killing livestock and leaving no tracks.

late.name: Wyvern over the Pastures
late.hook: A wyvern has made its nest above the best grazing in the realm.

early.name: Leaking Roofs
early.hook: Half the village roofs leak, and the thatcher is booked through spring.

middle.name: Tenement Fire
middle.hook: A fire tore through crowded housing. People need roofs before the cold comes.

late.name: The Sinking Quarter
late.hook: A whole district of the city is slowly sinking into soft ground.
